description_zh: 创建 PolarDBX Search 实例
kebab_example: aliyun polardbx create-open-search --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --pay-type PREPAY --zone-id cn-beijing-h --vpc-id 'vpc-*****' --vswitch-id 'vsw-*********' --db-node-class opensearch.sn2ne.large.1 --node-count 3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateOpenSearch

parameters.help_en: The region ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例所在地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:
PREPAY: subscription
POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
实例付费类型。

PREPAY：包年包月
POSTPAY：按量付费
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en: The zone of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例可用区
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The secondary zone. This parameter is required when TopologyType is set to 3azones, and the value must be different from other zones
parameters.help_zh: 第二可用区。TopologyType 为 3azones 时必填，且不能与其他可用区重复
parameters.name: zone_2

parameters.help_en: The third zone for Three-zone deployment. This parameter is required when TopologyType is set to 3azones, and the value must be different from other active zones
parameters.help_zh: 第三可用区。TopologyType 为 3azones 时必填，且不能与其他可用区重复
parameters.name: zone_3

parameters.help_en:
The active topology type. Valid values:
1azone: single-zone.
3azones: Three-zone deployment
parameters.help_zh:
拓扑类型：

1azone：单可用区。
3azones：三可用区
parameters.name: topology_type

parameters.help_en: The VPC ID
parameters.help_zh: VPC ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟交换机ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The database engine version of PolarDBX Search. The current fixed DPI engine version is 3.0. If this parameter is not specified, 3.0 is used
parameters.help_zh: PolarDBX Search 引擎版本。当前固定为 3.0；不传时使用 3.0
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en: The code for the node specifications of the PolarDBX Search data node. The active node specifications vary by region and sales configuration. Use a PolarDBX Search node specifications code that is available for purchase in the current region
parameters.help_zh: PolarDBX Search 数据节点规格代码。可用规格取决于地域和售卖配置，请使用当前地域可购买的 PolarDBX Search 规格代码
parameters.name: db_node_class

parameters.help_en: The number of PolarDBX Search data nodes. The value must be a positive integer and an integer multiple of the number of selected zones
parameters.help_zh: PolarDBX Search 数据节点数量。必须为正整数，并且是所选可用区数量的整数倍
parameters.name: node_count

parameters.help_en: A compatible parameter. This parameter does not take effect. Specify the node specifications of the PolarDBX Search data node by using DBNodeClass
parameters.help_zh: 兼容参数，当前不生效。请通过 DBNodeClass 指定 PolarDBX Search 数据节点规格
parameters.name: instance_spec

parameters.help_en: The storage type. Default value: cloud_auto
parameters.help_zh: 存储类型。默认值为 cloud_auto
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en: The storage space per node, in GB. The value must be a positive integer
parameters.help_zh: 单节点存储空间，单位为 GB。必须为正整数
parameters.name: storage_space

parameters.help_en: The description of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例备注描述
parameters.name: db_instance_description

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token. Make sure that the value is unique for each creation request
parameters.help_zh: 幂等请求串，保持每次创建不同即可
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. This parameter can be left empty and is not currently supported
parameters.help_zh: 可以为空，资源组ID，暂时不支持
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The billing cycle. For subscription instances, only Year and Month are supported. For pay-as-you-go instances, the default value is Hour
parameters.help_zh: 收费周期，包年包月只能选Year、Month， 按量付费默认选择Hour
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration. You can specify a duration in months or years for subscription instances.

When Period is set to Year, valid values for this parameter are 1, 2, and 3
parameters.help_zh:
预付费时，可以选择买几个月或者几年。

Period设置为Year时，该参数支持的取值为1、2、3
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Default value: true. Valid values:
true: enables auto-renewal
false: disables auto-renewal
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动续费，默认为true。

true：是
false：否
parameters.name: auto_renew

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details of the access denial

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en: The name of the security principal

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the security principal
